annotations.title: Enrich Creator Link-in-Bio Emails & Deal Readiness

description: Enrich creator Link-in-Bio pages across 15+ bio platforms with agency or business emails, DNS deliverability checks, and sponsorship readiness scores. Supply at least one source (urls, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId; omitting all returns 0 items at $0); enableDeepContactFollow toggles 1-hop personal-site crawling, while onlyWithEmail and minReadinessScore gate billing before charge. Streams up to 50,000 profiles in 50-item chunks at $2.50/1K enriched ($0 on 404, WAF, or filtered skips), isolating per-profile failures in OUTPUT_SUMMARY with optional webhookUrl delivery. Use for influencer and UGC sponsorship outreach; do not use for corporate B2B companies (use enrich_b2b_company_leads instead).

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset while preserving standard fields.

datasetId.description: Optional Apify Dataset ID or URL from an upstream Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube scraper (preserves upstreamHandle and upstreamFollowers).

enableDeepContactFollow.description: When no email is on the bio page, follow up to 2 personal website, Contact, or Media Kit links (1-hop, SSRF-safe, Cloudflare decoding included).

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) on custom creator/agency email domains.

maxConcurrency.description: Concurrent requests (1-20; capped automatically on 128-256 MB containers).

maxProfiles.description: Maximum unique creator bio URLs to process (1-50,000).

minReadinessScore.description: Minimum Creator Brand-Deal Readiness Score (0-100) required to save and bill.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only creators with at least 1 valid email ($0 when missing).

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV/TSV rows or newline-separated creator Link-in-Bio URLs.

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

urls.description: List of creator Link-in-Bio URLs or handles, e.g. ["https://linktr.ee/heathertraska", "https://stan.store/stan"]. Optional when rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId is provided.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL notified with run metrics and top creators on completion.

name: enrich_creator_bio_leads

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Enriched creator outreach profiles from Link-in-Bio pages.

emails.description: All discovered creator contact email entries.

inboxType.description: Inbox risk classification (management_agency, creator_direct, general, cs_ticket_queue, or none).

platform.description: Detected bio platform (linktree, stan_store, beacons, etc.).

primaryEmail.description: Prioritized talent agency or business email.
